task_text: 给定视频在网上流传。找到它的原始来源视频，并确定这一版与原片相比是否有改动、改在哪里：删掉、添加、调换或改变了哪些部分，给出两个视频中的时间。引用具体证据，说明未能确定的内容。
task_text_en: The given video circulated online. Find its original source video and determine whether and how this version differs from the original: which parts were removed, added, reordered or altered, with times in both videos. Cite specific evidence, and state what could not be determined.

requirements.text: 给定视频的原始来源视频（地址、频道或标题），以及据以认定的画面对应证据
requirements.text_en: The original source video of the given video (address, channel or title), and the picture correspondence that identifies it

requirements.text: 给定视频与原片的差异：至少指出一处删掉 / 添加 / 调换 / 改变的部分，并引用比对记录
requirements.text_en: How the given video differs from the original: name at least one part that was removed, added, reordered or altered, citing the comparison

requirements.text: 未能确定的内容（未比对的模态、边界精度等）
requirements.text_en: What could not be determined (modalities not compared, boundary precision, etc.)

required_evidence.description: 原片：YouTube cBWdFgsqyVU（FMNV CE 类假视频的来源，标题：US Election 2024 | Trump Warns Election 'Cheaters' Ahead Of Debate With Kamala Harris）
材料与原片的 compare_media 比对结果（报告据以指出至少一处差异）

checks.note: 原片 URL 必须引用
报告指出至少一处与原片的差异并引用比对记录（存在性，不做区间 IoU）
